title: Bechet at Nick's and getting Zutty out
summary: Zutty got Bechet in at Nick's, where Nick disliked the fish horn, and Bechet later wanted the Spirits of Rhythm out and Zutty fired. Marge says he wanted to be the star and was mean.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Did you ever hear that record he made in Paris of the ballet music? It's called 'The Night of the Sorcerer'. And it's like a, you know it's like ballet music. It's a small symphony and then right in the middle of it, here comes (Bashey?) you know with that big sound. It's very cute. You never heard that?
I'll put it on tape for you, it's quite amusing.

I wish you would. Boy when I begged to Nick (Boyd Denicke) who (Bashey?) was, you know? So (Bashey?) played with us that night. He sat in with the band. And Nick told me he says, I don't like that fish horn. Get that fish horn out of here. Say I don't like it. So finally, (Bashey?) and the Spirits of Rhythm and myself we went back into Nick's. And of course old Nick had found out just who (Bashey?) was, see? Because at that time old (Bashey?) had him a pressing shop. He wasn't doing nothing you know. And boy, we got back in there and he'd come up to our house and talk about the Spirits of Rhythm. How he wanted to .....
I said, get him out of there.
Wanted to get like, worried Margie to death see?

The spirituals. And wanted Zutty to go to the union with him and to put a knock in against them that they weren't acting right. They were getting drunk and all, get them out. And Zutty said I'm not going to tear up the group.

Finally, after all of this going on, Nick tells me one night, he say, Zutty, he say, the old man say he can't get along with you. And old Bechet and I hadn't had any trouble or anything like that. But he just wanted me out after me getting him in there.
So he could be the star.
Oh yes, yes. And Zutty had given him an overcoat and we were giving him breakfast every day and dinner. I didn't have to fix breakfast for Zutty.
Well this is the thing you know. I've heard that he was kind of mean.
Oh he was a mean cat, boy.
